key.name: effect
key.description: One of: aurora, blueprint, circuit, coderain, constellation, linkfield, meshwarp, neural, nodegraph, particles, phaseflow, radar, scanner, signalrings, wavegrid

key.name: effect-config
key.description: JSON dict keyed by effect name. Each value is an object of knob overrides, e.g. {"aurora":{"speed":1.5}}. Missing keys fall back to the manifest defaults.

key.name: background-mode
key.description: 'solid' paints background-color behind the effect; 'transparent' lets the real GNOME wallpaper show through (only useful when the compositor renders us on the background layer).

key.name: background-color
key.description: CSS color string. Hex like '#000000' or any valid css color name.

key.name: paused
key.description: When true, the renderer is paused and uses 0% CPU. Toggled by the panel menu or the panic keybinding when the machine struggles.

key.name: panic-key
key.description: Global shortcut that toggles the renderer paused/resumed. Designed as an unconditional escape hatch when an expensive effect/FPS combo locks the machine.

key.name: fps
key.description: Frames per second the in-shell renderer aims for. Lower values cut CPU/GPU use significantly; 24 is usually plenty for ambient wallpaper motion.

key.name: opacity
key.description: 0 hides the effect entirely (real wallpaper shows through), 100 is fully opaque.
